title: Make the provisioned Linux Vulkan SDK glslang include lookup case-tolerant
body: Fresh gpuyield configure: cmake --preset vixen-wsl -S VIXEN -B build/gpuyield -DYEROKET_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy printed Fatal Error: glslang directory not found at x86_64/Include/glslang although provisioning supplies x86_64/include/glslang. Recovery uses the documented worktree-local ln -s include VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk/1.4.350.1/x86_64/Include and reconfigures through the live queue. Resolve the actual SDK include directory in provisioning/finder rather than requiring manual casing aliases.

title: Size VIXEN queued build credits from the requested compiler parallelism
body: gpuyield-baseline-apps-checks requested resource build with cmake --build build/gpuyield --parallel 4 and stayed queued for more than twelve minutes needing three CPU tokens, with only one available. The owned waiting wrapper was cancelled before any target ran (exit 143, inconclusive baseline). The documented recovery --resource build --credits 1 with --parallel 2 admitted immediately and is compiling fresh targets under the live queue and its unchanged memory gate. Derive the admission request from explicit build parallelism, or publish a supported low-footprint VIXEN entry point, instead of requiring a manual credits override.

title: Derive compute pipeline dispatch-base capability from bounded command recording
body: R477 tiles use vkCmdDispatchBase, but ComputePipelineCacher has no declared dispatch capability to derive VK_PIPELINE_CREATE_DISPATCH_BASE_BIT. This lane must add the flag manually to every cached compute pipeline. Consolidate pipeline capability derivation with graph command requirements; preserve compatible cached pipelines without a parallel registry.

title: Preserve compute builtin dependencies in the existing shader reflection contract
body: R477 must perform a separate SPIRV-Reflect module inspection to avoid changing gl_NumWorkGroups in generic compute shaders. Existing SpirvReflectionData/cache metadata discards this dependency, so dispatch code cannot derive tile eligibility from its ordinary bundle metadata. Consolidate consumed builtin IDs into the existing reflection result and cache format, then derive dispatch/pipeline capability from that result.

title: Make zero-count Vulkan submit payload copies safe without pointer arithmetic
body: The existing SubmitRecord adapter formed pointer+0 ranges even when Vulkan permits a null array pointer with count zero. The new semaphore-only completion test required manual guards for every optional array. Consolidate zero-count handling in the existing native payload adapter conventions so producers do not need caller-side fake storage.

title: Make CodeGraph first queries usable in isolated VIXEN worktrees
body: The required first query, codegraph explore --path . --max-files 4 GPU submission dispatch frame pacing timestamp, exited 1 because this isolated worktree had no CodeGraph index. A second wrapper query also had no index. The lane continued its read-only inventory with rg rather than running an expensive new index. Publish or reuse a matching content-addressed index for lane worktrees, or make the mandated first query expose a supported lightweight fallback.

title: Share configured Vulkan runtime environment with standalone GPU witness tools
body: The R477 second-client witness needed a manually written worktree-local runtime-env.sh, sourced before tools/measure-gpu-cadence.py, exporting VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/home/liory/.cache/vixen/wsl-vulkan/dzn_icd.json and LD_LIBRARY_PATH entries for the provisioned Vulkan loader, Dozen and windowing libraries. CTest already derives this environment, and the windowed capture script duplicates its derivation, but the standalone native probe cannot consume it. Expose the existing configured runtime environment to witness commands so new probes do not hand-maintain SDK, driver and loader paths.

title: Declare CPU concurrency requirements for mixed GPU RenderGraph suites
body: The fresh merged full command, with-test-lock.sh --agent gpuyield --resource gpu --credits 1 -- env -u DISPLAY -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY -u VK_ICD_FILENAMES -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH ctest --test-dir build/gpuyield -L RenderGraph|SVO --output-on-failure --parallel 1, received two CPU cores. FramePipelineTest.AdjacentFramesOverlapButCommitInSubmissionOrder failed with maxActive=1: two queued TBB tasks serialized while the caller waited. The unchanged fresh test_rendergraph_coresystems_b binary passed the same filtered test with --resource test --credits 2 (four cores), max concurrency assertion intact. FramePipeline.h, TaskExecutor.cpp and this fixture are unchanged from 5da61a18. Convey the suite CPU concurrency requirement to the queue from existing test metadata instead of discovering an extra credits override manually.

title: Require registered CTest launcher scripts to be tracked and present
body: After merging wave 742fddb6 into a5cc7f33, the required RenderGraph test vixen_multiinstance_cache_gate immediately failed: python3.14 cannot open VIXEN/tools/multiinstance_cache_gate.py (ENOENT). Neither that path nor repository-root tools/multiinstance_cache_gate.py exists, and git ls-tree of the latest fetched wave contains no corresponding script. VIXEN/.gitignore:80 ignores tools/. The registered CMake command cannot be repaired by changing paths or regenerating code; its handwritten launcher was omitted from the merge. Require configuration to validate registered script presence and tracked ownership, and have the owner land the intended launcher with git add -f or an appropriate ignore exception. Do not manufacture a weaker substitute test or silently disable the gate.
